hypotheses.rationale: Morning activity at 07:34 aligns with commute prep. Afternoon/evening activity at 16:11-19:14 suggests return from work and evening routine. This pattern is consistent across two weekdays.
Still possible if 07:34 is waking up after a night shift and 16:11 is preparing for sleep, but the 12:31 midday activity makes this less likely than a standard schedule.
The structured timing (07:34, 12:31, 16:11) is less typical for a retiree, who might have more fluid schedules. However, if object_14/15 are leisure items, this could still hold.

selected_evidence: Day 0, 07:34 — object_10 at receptacle_3 (Morning routine start; timing aligns with commute prep or waking up)
Day 0, 12:31 — object_13 at receptacle_10 (Midday activity; could be lunch prep, work break, or household maintenance)
Day 1, 16:11 — object_14 at receptacle_11 (Late afternoon activity; likely return from work or start of evening routine)
Day 1, 19:14 — object_15 at receptacle_11 (Evening activity; consistent with post-work wind-down or dinner prep)
notes: Need to identify objects 10, 13, 14, 15 to confirm hypotheses. Object_14 at 16:11 is a strong discriminator for work return. Need to observe weekend patterns (Day 5-6) to see if the 07:34 and 16:11 timings persist or shift significantly.
